title: A CHINATOWN KING LEAR (SPONSORED)
description: Primary Stages presents LAOWANG By Alex Lin Directed by Joshua Kahan Brody With Cindy Cheung, Wai Ching Ho, Amy Keum, Jon Norman Schneider, and Daisuke Tsuji. A caustic and imaginative spin on King Lear that explores the changing face of America’s Chinatowns and the fight to preserve a fading cultural memory.
address: 59E59 Theaters – a quick block from SUBWAY 4/5/6 N/W/R at 59 St.
